title: Upload exercise data like step count to Tidepool
symptom: User requests that xDrip+ send step count to Tidepool, noting that xDrip+ displays steps graphically on the home screen and History screen, and asks if Tidepool supports steps in its app.
evidence_quote: Tidepool's API has an `exercise` data type, but it is currently not rendered at all in the Web UI.
